aPropos.p1: Gest-224 was born from a simple observation: running the commercial side of a small business — quotes, invoices, purchase and delivery orders, basic accounting — still often relies on makeshift spreadsheets or tools built for large organizations, too heavy for a freelancer or a very small business.
aPropos.p2: We're building a platform that handles the full document chain — from quote to invoice, through purchase order, delivery note, deposit invoice and credit note — following French and European invoicing rules: gapless sequential numbering, mandatory legal notices, VAT exemption handling (art. 293 B of the French tax code), late-payment penalties.
aPropos.p3: On top of that, simplified accounting: income is generated automatically when an invoice is marked as paid, expenses are entered in a few clicks, and a dashboard gives a clear view of the balance and monthly activity — without turning the user into an accountant.
aPropos.p4: Gest-224 is still a young product, continuously developed and improved. Structured e-invoicing (Factur-X, PDP) is on our roadmap, in anticipation of upcoming French regulatory deadlines.

legalCgu.intro: These terms of use ("Terms") govern access to and use of the Gest-224 platform (the "Service"), available in particular at gest-224.onrender.com. By creating an account, you accept these Terms without reservation.
legalCgu.s1Corps: Gest-224 is an online business management software (SaaS) that allows a business (the "User") to create and manage quotes, purchase orders, delivery notes, invoices, deposit invoices and credit notes, as well as simplified accounting tracking (revenue and expenses).

Information provided at sign-up must be accurate and kept up to date. The User is responsible for the confidentiality of their credentials and for any activity carried out from their account.
legalCgu.s3Corps: The User agrees to use the Service in accordance with its intended purpose and applicable regulations, particularly regarding commercial invoicing. The User is in particular prohibited from: any fraudulent use (fake invoices, identity theft), any attempt to access another business's data without authorization, and any use of the Service for unlawful purposes.
legalCgu.s4Corps: Gest-224 provides tools for generating documents that comply with French invoicing rules (numbering, mandatory notices), but the accuracy of the information entered (identity, amounts, VAT rates, tax regime) is the sole responsibility of the User. Gest-224 does not replace accounting, tax, or legal advice.

legalConfidentialite.intro: This policy describes how Gest-224 collects, uses, and protects personal data processed as part of the Service, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act (loi Informatique et Libertés).
legalConfidentialite.s1Corps: To be completed before commercial launch: company name, legal form, address, and contact email of the Gest-224 publisher, acting as data controller within the meaning of the GDPR.
legalConfidentialite.s2Item1Reste: : last name, first name, email, password (hashed, never stored in plain text).
legalConfidentialite.s2Item2Reste: : company name, SIRET number, address, VAT regime, bank details (IBAN/BIC) if provided, logo.
legalConfidentialite.s2Item3Reste: : information about the User's own clients (name, address, email, phone, SIRET number where applicable) and about the business documents they issue.
legalConfidentialite.s2Item4Reste: : IP address (used only to limit login attempts), and technical logs necessary for the operation and security of the Service.
legalConfidentialite.s2Corps: Gest-224 does not install any advertising or tracking cookies. Only a session cookie, strictly necessary for authentication, is used.
legalConfidentialite.s3Item1: Provision of the Service (performance of the contract);
legalConfidentialite.s3Item2: Issuance of business documents compliant with French regulations (legal obligation);
legalConfidentialite.s3Item3: Security of the Service and fraud prevention (legitimate interest);
legalConfidentialite.s3Item4: Billing of the subscription for paid plans (performance of the contract).
legalConfidentialite.s4Corps: Account data is retained for as long as the account is active. Business documents (quotes, invoices, credit notes) are retained in accordance with legal requirements for retaining accounting and business records under French law (in principle 10 years from the end of the financial year, article L123-22 of the French Commercial Code), even after account deletion where required by law.
legalConfidentialite.s5Intro: Data is hosted and processed by the following providers, as part of their respective roles:
legalConfidentialite.s5Item2: Database: Supabase, on AWS infrastructure in the Europe region (Paris, eu-west-3);
legalConfidentialite.s5Item3: Subscription payments: Stripe, when card payment is used;
legalConfidentialite.s5Item4: Transactional emails (password reset): Resend, when configured.
legalConfidentialite.s5Corps: No data is sold to third parties or used for advertising purposes.
legalConfidentialite.s6Part1: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, and object with respect to your data. The right to rectification and access to your data can be exercised directly from your workspace (Company, Clients pages). The right to erasure can be exercised immediately and without any formality from the "danger zone" on the Company page, which permanently deletes your account and all your data (subject to the legal retention obligations mentioned in section 4). For any other request, contact us at the address given in the
legalConfidentialite.s6Corps2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority (Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés, CNIL), www.cnil.fr.
legalConfidentialite.s7Corps: Passwords are hashed (bcrypt), connections to the Service are encrypted (HTTPS), and each company's data access is strictly isolated at the application level. Login attempts are rate-limited to prevent brute-force attacks.
legalConfidentialite.s2CorpsAudience: Pages on the public site (home, about, pricing, legal pages) are measured with a strictly anonymous, self-hosted analytics system with no third-party provider: only the path visited and the referring site's domain are recorded, with no cookie, no IP address, and no identifier that could link two visits together.
